glosses: A person who has, shows or expresses sympathy (with another person or people); a person who enters into the feelings of another.

examples.text: […] it is a sad case when the truly godly, who are cordial sympathizers, and earnest intercessours in the straits of a Nation, are stricken dumb in a day of calamity […]
